text:
raj: Quick ask — can someone run a very small pairwise smoke between A100 / H100 / L40S to sanity-check the kernel fallback change from yesterday? No heavy sweep, just 1-2 runs per SKU with the new thin-batch path. Need p50/p95/p99 and a short note if any thermal/clk throttling observed.

mike: I can take A100 + L40S this afternoon. planning to do bs=1 and bs=8, ctx=2048. will report p50/p95/p99 and GPU temp trace.

jess: will cover H100. also will test with nvlink enabled/disabled (where available) — last change touched the NVLink memcpy path so want to double-check.

anya: for consistency, please use: 
```
./run_bench.py --model=mpt-7b --ctx=2048 --iters=120 --warmup=20 --batch={1,8} --quant=none --export=csv
```
include kernel flags: `USE_THIN_BATCH=1` vs `0` in the run metadata.

ciara: environment notes: ubuntu20.04, driver 535.86, cudnn 8.9.2, container image: redwood/bench:2026-03. please paste `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,utilization.gpu --format=csv` snapshot at start/end.

benchbot: automated note: queued bench jobs for raj ticket #PI-1422. job ids: 9873 (A100), 9874 (L40S), 9875 (H100). will post logs when complete. :robot_face:

mike: quick results (A100): csv attached inline: 
```
sku,bs,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,temp_start,temp_end,notes
A100,1,12.4,18.9,24.1,46,53,stable
A100,8,9.7,14.3,20.8,47,58,slight-temp-rise
```
no throttling but fans at ~70% on the second run.

mike: L40S smoke: 
```
L40S,1,13.0,19.5,26.0,49,62,observed-bigger-p99
L40S,8,10.5,16.2,23.5,50,66,thermal-spike-on-2nd-iter
```
looks like p99 delta vs A100 ~+2-3ms, and temp rise bigger for L40S (maybe different fan profile).

jess: H100 (nvlink on): 
```
H100,1,11.8,17.0,22.5,45,50,clean
H100,8,9.1,13.5,18.7,46,52,clean
```
nvlink off gave near-identical numbers for single-host tests. no thermal issues.

anya: thanks — mike/jess can you paste the exact `USE_THIN_BATCH` env used? we need to confirm fallback vs fast path metrics.

mike: used `USE_THIN_BATCH=1`. I also ran `=0` once — p99 on A100 went to 28.7ms (so big regression if fallback stuck). will attach the small log to the ticket.

jess: H100 runs used `USE_THIN_BATCH=1` as well. with `0` H100 p99 ~30ms for bs=1, so same pattern.

ciara: tagging infra: @infra — can you check the L40S power profile? bench logs show temp_end 66C then fan ramp. might be a firmware/profile difference.

benchbot: logs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/bench/logs/9873,https://internal.redwood/bench/logs/9874,https://internal.redwood/bench/logs/9875

raj: summary from me: thin-batch path gives ~15-20% p99 improvement across H100/A100/L40S vs fallback. fallback p99 regressed ~+6-8ms. action items: (1) eng-runtime to gate the kernel change behind a config flag defaulting to ON; (2) infra to verify L40S fan/firmware anomaly; (3) benches + CSVs to be attached to PI-1422.

mike: uploaded csvs to s3: s3://redwood-bench/pi-1422/smoke_pairwise/ (files: a100.csv l40s.csv h100.csv)

anya: I'll open a quick PR to add the runtime config flag and a unit test that asserts fallback path only used when env var toggled.

raj: perfect — please @mention me on the PR. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
